description: Curated evidence-linked research graph seed, falsifiable questions and review candidates. Reports and status are text sources, never scientific authority; cataloged files are unreviewed.

source_checks.marker: general adaptive benefit at L3 is **NOT_ESTABLISHED**
A1-C confirmatory result was a targeted **NO_GO**
Architectural and scientific review still required

questions.question: Does a born individual adapt usefully in independent unfamiliar worlds?
questions.missing_evidence: New preregistered independent-world mortal lives with controls, exact-SHA traces and a causal decision witness.

questions.question: Can lived intention persist without inherited motor authority?
questions.missing_evidence: Independent G1 review and negative motor/UC/veto/expiration controls followed by lived tests.
questions.negative_or_null: Synthetic G2 code does not establish physical causality.

questions.question: Can personally experienced preparation receive valid delayed credit?
questions.missing_evidence: Neutral, reversed, adverse and novel-world controls, with actual physical consequences.
questions.negative_or_null: Retrospective I1 results cannot certify improvement.

questions.question: Can needs, exploration, sleep and learned value arbitrate under real costs?
questions.missing_evidence: Independent tracing of exposure, Q read, Competition, veto, admission, physical action, UC and survival.
questions.negative_or_null: Option preference in a synthetic fixture is not a living action.

gates.label: Independent review of hypotheses, ownership, crash boundaries
Independent living WorldBody, UC, M11 and adversarial safeguards
Explicit human scientific and architecture decision

interventions.title: Independently review I2 contracts before more implementation
interventions.action: Review H1–H3, UC, expiry, motor veto, publication ownership, M11 crash and negative controls; record an external review.
interventions.expected_knowledge: Identify contradictions and missing guarantees blocking G3.
interventions.disconfirming_result: Unresolved crash, rollback or privileged motor state invalidates readiness.

interventions.title: Secure original I1 G0 evidence before provider expiry, then independently verify custody
interventions.action: Before the scheduled 28 Nov 2026 Actions artifact expiry, arrange authorized preservation of 8 A1-P and 48 A1-C original-life artifacts and both aggregates. Compare downloaded inner originals to frozen hashes; attest independently durable copies and protect the archive Git ref.
interventions.expected_knowledge: Resolve which original bytes and exact-source archives are independently retrievable, what negative results remain and what trust/custody gaps block G0.
interventions.disconfirming_result: Provider metadata alone, a failed A1-P aggregate, missing originals, non-protected Git refs or inaccessible external copies keep G0 PARTIAL.
deliverables: Operator export receipts for 58 provider artifacts
Independent durable custody and reviewer access attestation

interventions.title: Falsify I2 independent custody before building a living runtime
interventions.action: Model crash windows, anti-rollback outside the local SQLite, terminal seals, double-writer fencing and physical exactly-once effects.
interventions.expected_knowledge: Determine which trust domains and witnesses are not independently established.
interventions.disconfirming_result: Local hashes or injected witnesses alone cannot prove M11 independence.

interventions.title: Reassess what I1 scientifically demonstrated
interventions.action: Separate current software coverage, historical NO_GO, 0/96 A2-R and the smallest falsifiable residual claim.
interventions.expected_knowledge: Pin actual failures and evidence gaps rather than increase test count.
interventions.disconfirming_result: No generalizable effect or missing traces retains NOT_ESTABLISHED.

interventions.title: Design G3 independent I2 only after G1 approval
interventions.action: Specify genuinely independent WorldBody, true UC, action admission, M11 and irreversible death without I1 imports.
interventions.expected_knowledge: Make software gates and failure cases independently testable.
interventions.disconfirming_result: Synthetic G2 cannot substitute for a living independent runtime.

interventions.title: Preregister unbiased I1/I2 comparison
interventions.action: Lock independent worlds, matched births, controls, N/H, censoring, predeclared statistics and stopping rules.
interventions.expected_knowledge: Prevent post-hoc success criteria and enable falsification.
interventions.disconfirming_result: Bias, leaked truth, insufficient controls invalidate a study.

interventions.title: Conduct preregistered independent lives only after G0–G4
interventions.action: Compare independent I1/I2 births, physically lived evidence, actual outcomes and negative controls.
interventions.expected_knowledge: Test whether experience drives useful durable adaptation.
interventions.disconfirming_result: Null or adverse effect is NO_GO or inconclusive, never an automatic promotion.

interventions.title: Request explicit human promotion review
interventions.action: Submit reviewed experimental evidence, architecture safeguards and unresolved risks; do not change engine registry.
interventions.expected_knowledge: Clarify whether I2 is genuinely supported or remains a proposal.
interventions.disconfirming_result: Failed gates or missing evidence retain I1 active.

findings.summary: The A1-C preregistered targeted study did not meet its confirmatory criterion.
findings.scope_limit: This does not by itself disprove every possible architecture or establish I2 effectiveness.
Missing trials cannot be counted as positive, negative, or inconclusive measured lives.

findings.summary: Generalized autonomous adaptive benefit at L3 is not scientifically established.
findings.scope_limit: A source-text match is not a new scientific assessment of HEAD.

findings.summary: G2 implements controlled synthetic research fixtures, not independent living-world mechanisms.
findings.scope_limit: No causal physical-world, living-birth, motor or independent M11 authority follows.

findings.summary: Independent architecture/science review is still required for I2 G1.
findings.scope_limit: Issue or document updates do not equal an accepted review; verify independently.

findings.summary: I2 G3 does not yet establish independent living M11, UC, physical WorldBody and birth.
findings.scope_limit: Independent physics, authority and persistence require separate reviewed evidence.

findings.summary: On 1 Nov, 58 GitHub Actions artifacts existed (8+48 original-life wrappers, two aggregates) with scheduled expiry on 28 Nov; source archive branch was not protected. No durable independent custody was attested.
findings.scope_limit: Dated provider upload metadata is neither original inner M11 ZIP SHA verification, independent custody nor a new scientific outcome. A1-P eight life jobs succeeded while its aggregate job failed.
